label: Huawei 5G CPE Pro 2 indoor 5G router
description: Indoor 5G CPE on the Balong 5000 modem, 5G NR sub-6 NSA/SA rated 3.6 Gbps down / 250 Mbps up (3GPP Rel-15, UE downlink category 19). The wired side is two Gigabit Ethernet ports (1x WAN/LAN plus 1x LAN) with Wi-Fi 6 Plus dual-band at 574 + 2402 Mbps; the cellular uplink is carried as the Ethernet-class interface wan5g.
